items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Pygmeet Markham; the mention is solely from the interviewer ('I saw Pygmeet Markham at the Lyric').

ctx.x: That's gone. After when, what you call it, he hit him. He hit him. Whoopin' Fitchin'. He cut down all that. Oh, whoopin' Fitchin'. And everything.
I saw Pygmeet Markham at the Lyric. After they changed it to the palace. He still did some of those things.
Well, they had the palace and the... And the Lyric Boat. And the Lyric Boat. Yeah, well they had the palace.
